description.en: The node scale-out strategy. Valid values: COST_OPTIMIZED and PRIORITY. Default value: PRIORITY.
The region ID.

description.zh: 抢占式Spot实例价格上限。spotStrategy：SpotWithPriceLimit时生效
description.en: The maximum bid prices for spot instances. This parameter takes effect only when spotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

description.zh: 是否开启补齐抢占式实例。开启后，当收到抢占式实例将被回收的系统消息时，伸缩组将尝试创建新的实例，替换掉将被回收的抢占式实例。默认值：false
description.en: Specifies whether to enable spot instance supplementation. If this feature is enabled, the scaling group attempts to create new instances to replace spot instances that are about to be reclaimed when the system sends a reclamation notification. Default value: false.
The vSwitch ID.
